text: Senior backend engineer with 8 years building Python services. Designed FastAPI and Django REST APIs, async SQLAlchemy data layers, and PostgreSQL schemas serving millions of requests per day.
Frontend engineer specializing in React, TypeScript, and Next.js. Built component libraries, accessible design systems, and performant single-page apps with server-side rendering.
Data scientist with a PhD in statistics. Experienced in machine learning, NLP, and building recommendation models with PyTorch and scikit-learn, deployed behind production inference APIs.
DevOps engineer focused on Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD pipelines. Managed AWS infrastructure, container orchestration, autoscaling, and observability with Prometheus and Grafana.
Product manager who led cross-functional teams shipping B2B SaaS features. Skilled at roadmap prioritization, user research, A/B experimentation, and stakeholder communication.
Recent computer science graduate seeking a junior software role. Internship experience in Java and Spring Boot, strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and unit testing.
We are hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to own our Python microservices. You will design APIs, optimize database queries, and mentor junior engineers. FastAPI and PostgreSQL experience required.
Open role: Frontend Engineer. Build delightful user interfaces in React and TypeScript, collaborate with designers, and improve page-load performance. Five years of web experience expected.

Machine Learning Engineer wanted to productionize models. Responsibilities include training pipelines, feature engineering, model serving, and monitoring drift. PyTorch and Python proficiency required.
Engineering Manager opening to lead a team of eight. Drive technical strategy, run one-on-ones, grow careers, and partner with product on delivery. Prior people-management experience required.
Your offer includes 12,000 incentive stock options vesting over four years with a one-year cliff. Equity is granted at the fair market value set by the most recent 409A valuation.
We are pleased to offer a base salary of 165,000 dollars per year, paid semi-monthly, plus an annual performance bonus targeted at 15 percent of base.
Benefits include fully paid medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401k with company match, and a flexible unlimited paid-time-off policy with a minimum two-week expectation.
Your anticipated start date is March 3rd. This offer is contingent on completion of a background check and verification of your eligibility to work in the United States.
Sourcing note: reached out to a passive candidate on LinkedIn who is a staff engineer at a fintech startup. Not actively looking but open to a conversation about compensation and remote work.
Sourcing note: strong employee referral for the data team. The referrer worked with this candidate at a previous company and vouches for their SQL and dashboarding skills.
